name: Shaban Ahmad
bio: Shaban is a postdoctoral researcher (PhD, Artificial Intelligence in Biology; MSc Bioinformatics) working on AI-driven discovery of PFAS-degrading enzymes. His PFAS-Flow project mines fluoroacetate and haloacid dehalogenases from environmental sequence data and studies C–F bond cleavage mechanisms with QM/MM, feeding directly into the lab's FAcDs and HADs screening work. He also works more broadly on explainable AI methods for computational drug discovery and genomics.
